purpose: Convert the six provisional Bible comparator research relations into a concrete excavation batch. This file does not change relation strength, dossier level or chronology; it records source-backed findings, unresolved gaps and safe candidate enrichments for later promotion through existing relation owners.

policy.promotion_rule: Promote only fields supported by existing public owners or newly recovered primary evidence. Recovered wording must remain labeled recovered; contextual prose may improve navigability but cannot substitute for missing original artifacts, contemporaneous records or earlier attestations.

selection_basis.order: high priority first, then medium priority; within a priority tier preserve the existing research queue order
